description: Product-policy classification of every original frontend conceptual state/feature for the modern product layer. Applies the PROJECT-PLAN.md modernization/subtraction rule: presentation artifacts and gameplay mechanics are preserved; administrative or hardware-era systems may be redesigned in Modern mode. Authentic/reference mode always reproduces stock behavior for every feature listed here. This file records product decisions and open questions; it is not fidelity evidence and never overrides analysis/ui-state-map.yml or analysis/ui-transition-contract.json.
authentic_mode_invariant: Every feature is reproduced as stock behavior in Authentic/reference mode. A Modern-mode disposition never authorizes guest WRAM/SRAM/simulation changes; redesigns attach through host/product interfaces (docs/MODERN-PRODUCT-LAYER.md).

classes.presentation_artifact: Player-visible communication: menu art, motion, typography, palette, icons, sounds, result rituals, indicators, secrets/discovery affordances. Preserve by default; elaboration may be added alongside.
classes.gameplay_mechanic: Rules that change what the player does or achieves: race simulation, scoring, medal thresholds, unlock conditions, mode rules. Preserve unless an evidence-backed product decision record exists.
classes.administrative: Systems whose main purpose came from shared-cartridge saves, limited storage, 1994 menu/controller conventions or content-padding repetition. Eligible for Modern-mode redesign or removal.

dispositions.preserve: Modern mode keeps the original feature unchanged.
dispositions.preserve_and_augment: Modern mode keeps the original feature and adds clearer information, conveniences or host input alongside it.
dispositions.redesign_decided: Product policy already decided to redesign this administrative feature in Modern mode; implementation is pending. Requires policy_source.
dispositions.redesign_candidate: Administrative feature eligible for Modern-mode redesign; the decision is open. Requires decision_gate.

features.rationale: Startup and splash are original presentation with their own skip affordance; nothing about them is hardware-era administration.
Baseline requirement: preserve original attract/demo behavior and leave a clean hook for a local recorded-run showcase.
The ending is a reward presentation and the title-screen chord is a secret; secrets and advanced discoveries stay intentionally opaque. The chord itself is not yet locally verified.

Arrow cursor, menu art, motion, typography, palette and sounds are the recognizable menu character. Choices and grouping may change; the visual grammar may not be casually replaced. The decoded contract for typography, layout, cursor and slide transitions is analysis/generated/menu-visual-language.json.
A/B forward, X/Y back and D-pad cursor are the documented interaction character. Modern mode adds host keyboard support and rebinding without changing the guest-visible convention.
The five-entry 1P/2P/VS/LEAGUE/OPTIONS structure is navigation depth, not a mechanic. Modern practice/free-play, recent track and fast local multiplayer entry points may regroup it.
features.decision_gate: Modern frontend information architecture: practice/free-play route and fast local multiplayer join/setup.

features.rationale: Every named/color-coded unicycle remains an exact preset and may also serve as AI/ghost/tournament cast; player-created racers are added beside them. Exact preset data (index, default name, grid slot, medal column, ROM palette) is analysis/generated/legacy-cast-presets.json.
Named racers doubling as shared-cartridge save/profile slots is a storage-era constraint. Modern profiles separate save storage from racer identity.

Sequential P1-then-P2 selector handoff and the claimed-rider exclusion boundary follow from racers being save slots and one shared selector. Modern simultaneous join may replace it; the authentic handoff remains a Tier 1 fidelity oracle.
features.decision_gate: Fast local multiplayer join/setup design after the modern racer/profile model exists.

features.rationale: PICK CHALLENGER appears only after a decided VS race and is driven by the loser's pad; the challenger then chooses the next track (five options); draws rematch automatically. This winner-stays contest structure is a mode rule. Reproduced on snesref (R-2026-10-03-UI-10); native/Mesen confirmation pending.
Animal tour icons and track-type icons are original indicators. Modern mode may add recent-track, practice and PB/medal information alongside.
Tour availability and the hidden Hunter tour are progression rules and a discovery reward. Unlock transition evidence is still open (UIQ-010).
Per-track medal thresholds define achievement. Modern mode shows exact target/medal deltas beside the original indicators; thresholds themselves are canonical in analysis/data/progression-model.json.

Mandatory Bronze then Silver then Gold re-clears of the same tour are content-padding repetition. Performance-based awarding or selectable challenge tiers are the candidates; Bronsen, Silvia and Goldwyn stay as named opponents regardless.
features.decision_gate: Decide final modern medal/progression policy after original thresholds/state are mapped (WORK-QUEUE Phase 9).

features.rationale: The assumed session loss is not stock behavior: the battery-SRAM tour-win counter survives power-off and the next win continues it (R-2026-10-03-UI-01). Modern mode keeps that persistence and may surface in-tour progress, which the stock TRACK_SELECT never displays.
features.open_question: Whether completing a tour resumed across a power cycle awards the medal is unobserved.

features.rationale: The sliding NOW PLAYING matchup card and RACE/EXIT choice are original race-entry ritual; modern mode may add rematch/next-event shortcuts around it.
Authoritative race simulation, timers, stunt scoring and AI are never altered by product policy.
Original HUD indicators stay; exact timing, splits and PB deltas are shown in addition.

The stock RACE/timer/CONTINUE GAME/QUIT overlay stays guest-owned. The modern host pause menu (Resume, Restart, Options, Controls, Run Data, Quit) is a separate host overlay that never writes guest memory or reinterprets stock pause state.
Result screens, score tallies and summing animations are original result rituals. Modern PB/medal deltas, Retry and records links are added alongside.

Stock 1P results (race/circuit/stunt) drop straight to TRACK_SELECT. Stock VS already offers NEXT TRACK / SAME TRACK / SELECT TRACK / SELECT TOUR / QUIT after a decided race and an automatic REMATCH after a draw (R-2026-10-03-UI-10). The modern rematch/next-event affordance can therefore reuse VS's own choice set and visual grammar for 1P instead of inventing one.
features.decision_gate: Fast navigation affordances design; candidate is to extend the stock VS track-choice set to 1P results.

features.rationale: League standings and group tables are original score presentations; keep them reproducible as views even if League administration changes.
Persistent multi-league player management (up to six leagues of up to eight unicycles) is cartridge-era bureaucracy. A simplified modern tournament path is the candidate replacement.
features.decision_gate: Prototype a simplified modern League/tournament path (WORK-QUEUE Phase 9).

features.rationale: Left+A+L+R erase-all and SELECT+Y+A league redefinition become explicit, confirmed UI actions in Modern mode.
OPTIONS groups Records with player/league administration rather than settings. Modern settings are host-owned already; the hub may be regrouped once racer/profile and records surfaces exist.
features.decision_gate: Modern racer/profile model and unified records surface.

features.rationale: Four separate score/record screens behind a menu are a storage-era silo layout. A unified modern records surface may embed them as views.
Gold/Silver/Bronze record tables, player-color star markers and score layouts stay as original views inside any modern records browser.
The WHAT IS YOUR PLAYER CALLED screen and alphabet grid are original presentation.
Controller-only grid entry and fixed name lengths are hardware-era constraints. Keyboard entry and localization-ready text are the candidates.
features.decision_gate: Modern racer/profile model, practical keyboard support and localization-ready text architecture.

features.rationale: Modern mode accepts forbidden names: the stock detection rule (71-word table at 83:85C5, case-insensitive substring match by 83:84DD; analysis/generated/forbidden-name-table.json) triggers a COOL NAME! acknowledgement and then the name is kept. Rejection remains authentic/reference behavior only.
